unit.reason: Harness attempt 003 passed 283 focused tests with 795 assertions. Independent probes additionally confirmed a 200 KiB search match fails with output_limit and malformed profiles expose zero definitions and deny execution.

integration.reason: The recorded attempt passed 913 tests with four unchanged baseline failures. An independent post-fix full rerun passed 914 tests with the same four Codex app/config failures in paired-options.test.ts and runner.test.ts; no delta regression was introduced.
integration.method: verify.sh plus independent post-fix full suite

smoke.reason: Attempt 004 passed targeted formatting and static checks, build, and git diff --check. The evaluator rebuilt the post-fix tree, reran diff-check, and confirmed executable SHA-256 e04e60191aec2c63e200fc06f0a19693dcf65277b123b36eda5fe6e404e3474a.

resolved_findings.title: Search output exceeds the broker byte budget after the 1 MiB input-ceiling increase
resolved_findings.resolution: searchRepo now measures serialized matches against maxOutputBytes and returns output_limit; the 200 KiB regression and independent probe pass.

resolved_findings.title: Malformed execution profiles fail open to all broker tools
resolved_findings.resolution: The profile resolver now accepts untrusted input, reserves undefined for intentional unrestricted explicit requests, and maps unknown, non-string, and prototype-key values to an empty tool set; broker definitions and dispatch both enforce the denial.

git_metadata_parser_and_literal_argv.evidence: Supported refs, branch patterns, limits, command counts, pipelines, and chain segments use a narrow literal parser. Unsupported, mutating, network, mixed, option-like, and shell-expanded shapes remain direct. Broker actions construct fixed argv arrays and use the scrubbed bounded command runner.

execution_profile_restriction.evidence: Known automatic profiles expose and permit only the satisfiable broker tool. Absent explicit-request profiles retain legacy unrestricted behavior, while every malformed runtime value fails closed to zero tools.

bounded_read_and_search.evidence: read_file accepts a bounded range from a 135 KiB regular file and rejects selected output above 64 KiB. search_repo now rejects serialized matches above the same output budget despite the 1 MiB input ceiling.

governess_usage_regressions.evidence: Transcript rebinding, transient pricing fallback, and per-provider 60-second quota retention are preserved with passing regressions.

worker_runtime_budget.evidence: The worker conversation remains bounded by maxJobRuntimeMs only; no maxSteps, tool-round, or cumulative-job ceiling was reintroduced.

source_scope.evidence: Runtime changes are confined to the specified router, tool broker, worker execution-profile wiring, and governess usage integrations, plus their tests and Harness metadata.

notes: No deployment, push, or live tmux operation was performed.
The four full-suite failures are confirmed baseline failures and are not findings against this delta.
